name: Comic Market
blurb: The world's largest self-published doujinshi fair, held twice a year at Tokyo Big Sight for independent manga and fan circles.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'コミックマーケット１０９は、東京ビッグサイトにて2026年12月29日～31日の３日間開催です' (Comic Market 109 will be held at Tokyo Big Sight over three days, Dec 29-31, 2026).

notes: Comiket is a circle/doujinshi self-publishing fair with no celebrity guest program, so guests is set to 'none' rather than 'none-yet'.
